findings.body: The version updates satisfy the release requirement, but the required full-suite check is still red. The supplied forge close run exited with status 1: workers crashed during tests/test_codex_record.py::test_6_nothing_left_running and tests/test_proto_deploy.py::test_10_new_client_deploys_only_after_migration, leaving 2 failed, 625 passed and 1 skipped. Resolve the failures and obtain a passing run of forge.toml's test command (line 6) before marking this release complete. The evidence does not establish that the version bump caused either crash.
